newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks finish down, but off earlier lows.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks finish down, but off earlier lows.

text.p: Tokyo stocks finished down on Monday, but were able to recover somewhat from earlier lows as bargain-hunting offset some losses due to fresh selling interest in banking shares, brokers said. They said the direction of the market was unclear and participants were mostly sidelined.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 127.87 points, or 0.69 percent, to 18,429.13. Its March futures shed 150 points to end at 18,420.
"Mondays are usually slow," said Haruo Nakaharu, a director at Toyo Securities. "There were no direction-setting factors and the market carried over the negative sentiment from Friday."
